messages:
alexa: :wave: Quick sync — want to land the Design Partner intake + success criteria doc today so PMs/sales have a single checklist.
max: yes please. what's the ask? timeline?
alexa: We need a lightweight intake that captures: use-case, success metrics, data sensitivity, SLOs (latency/throughput), team contact, and expected integration effort. Then a short outreach template + incentives.
sanjay: Agree on fields. Also add an "evaluation hooks" section so we can attach a small prompt set and golden outputs for automated regression checks.
lisa: For recruitment incentives — cash vs credits vs co-marketing — we should tier by integration effort. offer: small pilots (2-4 weeks) = $2k or platform credits; deep integrations get co-marketing + dedicated eng time.
ritesh: From sales: target 6-8 customers in Q2 for private preview. I can put forward 12 names that fit compliance and have reachable POCs.
alexa: Great — can someone draft the intake form? I sketched a minimal version:

```
- company
- contact (name, role, email)
- primary use-case (1-2 sentences)
- expected traffic (rps, queries/day)
- data sensitivity (public/internal/regulated)
- integration timeline (days)
- success metrics (NRR impact, latency target, quality threshold)
- eval hook (link to test prompt set)
- NDA required? (Y/N)
```

max: clean. add a "rollback condition" field — i.e., conditions under which we pause the pilot (latency > 500ms p50 for 3 days or quality drop > X%).
sanjay: Also add "observability access" checkbox (team wants dashboards + logs) and "security checklist completed" checkbox for private/on-prem.
lisa: I'll draft the outreach copy and incentive table. prefer a 3-message cadence: intro -> brief ask -> follow-up with offer. keep it <150 words.
ritesh: Will sales handle contract/NDA? Also need to know if we require SOC2 or just standard NDA for pilot.
alexa: For private preview let's require signed NDA + security self-attestation. For Dedicated customers we'll escalate to SOC2/work with security if needed.
ops-bot: [ticket created] #DP-312 Intake template + outreach copy assigned to lisa. ETA 2 business days. link: https://rwd.internal/tickets/DP-312 :white_check_mark:
max: timeline check — onboarding window: we should allow 2 weeks for integration sandbox + 2 weeks of monitoring before claiming success. total 4 weeks per partner.
sanjay: Success criteria proposal: 1) integration complete & runbook verified, 2) quality above baseline (team-defined), 3) latency within SLO, 4) active weekly usage for 2 consecutive weeks.
alexa: Love it. For scope negotiation: add a short "must-have vs nice-to-have" checkbox list so partners know we won't build full custom features during pilot.
lisa: I'll include that in outreach and intake. also thinking of a small welcome packet: runbook, test set, support contacts, and demo video.
ritesh: Once lisa has outreach, I'll start contacting my list. any quick golden prompts we should attach? maybe 10 diverse examples per use-case.
sanjay: yep, 8-12 prompts is fine. include edge-cases / sensitive examples for regression detection.
alexa: Action items: lisa drafts outreach + incentive table (ETA 48h), sanjay and max draft eval hooks & rollback thresholds (ETA 48h), ritesh shares candidate list (ETA 24h), ops-bot to create the intake form and pipeline. We'll review Friday 10am PT.
ops-bot: [reminder set] Review DP intake + outreach — Fri 10:00 PT. attendees: alexa, max, sanjay, lisa, ritesh.
max: :rocket: Good plan. I can help with integration runbook templates.
alexa: Thanks team — will capture notes into the DP repo after the meeting and link back here. :eyes:
